definitions.explanation: Done with great care and attention to detail, leaving nothing overlooked.

examples.japanese: {入念|にゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
{入念|にゅうねん}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入念|にゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見落|みお}とし→見落とし：14273_miotoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ようにした。
examples.english: He carefully refined his plan, making sure not to overlook a single thing.

notes:
A な-adjective that emphasizes meticulous care and thoroughness. Used primarily as a modifier ({入念|にゅうねん}な + noun) or adverbially ({入念|にゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb). Common in both spoken and written Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入念|にゅうねん}な⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: thorough preparation
- {入念|にゅうねん}な⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: careful investigation
- {入念|にゅうねん}な⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: meticulous plan
- {入念|にゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check carefully
- {入念|にゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to maintain carefully

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧: polite, careful — broader, includes politeness in manner
- ⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧: cautious, prudent — emphasizes avoiding mistakes or risk
- ⟦{念入|ねんい}り→念入り：14892_neniri⟧: thorough, careful — very close synonym, slightly more common in everyday speech
